admission.hero_subtitle: Join DAARA Al Amine Academy by following our simple and transparent registration steps.
admission.cta_subtitle: Fill in these 4 fields and send your request directly via WhatsApp. Our team replies within the day.
admission.form_privacy: Your information stays confidential. We only use it to contact you about your registration.
admission.steps_subtitle: Follow these 4 simple steps to enroll your child
admission.step1_desc: Fill in our online form with your child's information and your contact details.
admission.step2_desc: An interview with the management to discuss goals and program fit.
admission.step3_desc: Finalize enrollment and pay the fees. Immediate confirmation by email.
admission.step4_desc: Welcome to DAARA! Classes begin according to the school calendar.
admission.fees_note: The enrollment fee is due once at the time of registration. Monthly fees are payable at the beginning of the month or per agreed arrangements.
admission.faq1_q: What is the minimum age for enrollment?
admission.faq1_a: For both of our current programs — Tahfiz Boarding and the Day Program — admission is strictly limited to children aged 6 to 12, with no exceptions below or above.
admission.faq2_a: Yes, we offer partial scholarships for academically sound and financially modest families. Please contact us to discuss your situation.
admission.faq3_q: How long is the school year?
admission.faq3_a: The school year generally runs from September to July. We have school breaks in December and August. Exact schedules are provided at enrollment.
admission.faq4_q: Can I change my program choice after enrollment?
admission.faq4_a: Yes, changes can be made up to the end of the first school month with management approval and at no extra cost.
admission.faq5_a: Online classes are held via Google Meet on Saturday and Sunday afternoons (12 PM–5 PM), with follow-up between sessions via WhatsApp group. 10,000 FCFA/month for group class (25,000 FCFA individual).
admission.faq6_a: Yes, all meals served at the academy are 100% halal. Three balanced meals per day plus a snack are included for boarding students. We adapt menus for allergies and specific needs on request.
admission.faq7_q: Can my child come home on weekends?
admission.faq7_a: Yes. For the boarding program (Tahfiz), students can return home every weekend (Friday evening to Sunday evening) according to the schedule agreed with parents. For the Mixed program, also a boarding program, the child returns home every two weeks.
admission.faq8_a: No written exam. A 30-minute interview with the management assesses the child's level (reading, memorization already acquired) and guides them toward the right program. The goal is to welcome, not select.
admission.faq9_q: What documents are required for enrollment?
admission.faq9_a: Child's birth certificate, two recent ID photos, one parent's ID card, medical certificate less than 3 months old, and previous year's school reports. For boarding students, a blood type certificate is required.
admission.faq10_q: What payment methods do you accept?
admission.faq10_a: Cash on site, Wave, Orange Money, or bank transfer. Payment is monthly; quarterly payment gives a 2% discount and annual payment gives 5%.
admission.faq11_q: How does night supervision and medical emergency handling work?
admission.faq11_a: Supervision is provided 24/7, with adults sleeping alongside the children, under video surveillance and under a strict "zero corporal punishment" policy. In a medical emergency, the child is cared for immediately and parents are contacted without delay at +221 77 774 37 00 (also reachable via WhatsApp, available 24/7); for any non-urgent medical decision, prior parental consent is required.
admission.faq12_q: Can I visit my child during the week?
admission.faq12_a: Weekday visits remain occasional and are arranged on request with the administration. Returning home stays the norm: every weekend for Tahfiz Boarding, every two weeks for the Day Program.

programme_internat.security_title: A safe environment, free of any violence
programme_internat.security_intro: Entrusting your child to a boarding school requires absolute trust. Our rules on safety, hygiene and discipline are explicit and without exception.
programme_internat.security_1_desc: An absolute rule with no exceptions. Sanctions are strictly educational.
programme_internat.security_2_desc: Adult residents sleep with the children to ensure their safety at all times.
programme_internat.security_3_desc: Every Sunday, a 10-minute voice call with parents. Video calls are allowed.
programme_internat.security_4_desc: No health decision is made without contacting you, except in life-threatening emergencies — immediate hospital care with a call right after.
programme_internat.faq_q1: Does an adult sleep with the children at night?
programme_internat.faq_a1: Yes. Some of the adult residents sleep with the children at night to ensure their safety and supervision at all times.
programme_internat.faq_q2: Do children only learn the Quran, or also how to practice the religion?
programme_internat.faq_a2: They learn much more than memorization: the Oneness of Allah (Tawhid), Islamic jurisprudence (Fiqh) and daily invocations (Adhkar) are an integral part of the program.
programme_internat.faq_a3: Yes. 95% of staff have at least 3 years of experience. 80% hold a Bachelor's degree (L3) in English, management or Islamic sciences; 5% hold a Master's degree in management or Islamic sciences.
programme_internat.faq_q4: Can I reach my child during their stay?
programme_internat.faq_a4: Yes. Every Sunday, each child gets a 10-minute voice call with their parents. Video calls are also allowed.
programme_internat.faq_q5: How do you handle health issues?
programme_internat.faq_a5: We always contact parents first before any decision. In an extreme emergency that cannot wait, the child is taken to the hospital immediately and parents are notified right away.
programme_internat.faq_q6: What measures do you take for disciplinary issues?
programme_internat.faq_a6: No corporal punishment whatsoever. Educational sanctions include: withdrawal of recreational activities, extra study time or household chores. We apply a strictly violence-free method.
programme_internat.faq_q7: Who takes care of the children's hygiene?
programme_internat.faq_a7: Children aged 6 to 7 are assisted by a supervisor. Older children are checked daily; hygiene lapses result in educational sanctions.
programme_internat.faq_q8: Can children be hit if they misbehave?
programme_internat.faq_a8: No, absolutely not. Staff are strictly forbidden from ever laying a hand on a child. This is an absolute rule with no exceptions at Al Amine Academy.

fiche.subtitle: Information Sheet

fiche.tahfiz_intro: Full memorization of the Noble Quran in an environment conducive to concentration, with quality pedagogical supervision.

aides_sociales.partner_desc: DAARA Al Amine Academy is the official representative of CollecteSadaqa.com in Senegal. We carry out the same humanitarian and social activities: building educational complexes, orphan sponsorship, food distribution, solidarity packages and support for families in need.
aides_sociales.actions_desc: The same commitments as CollecteSadaqa.com, deployed locally in Senegal
aides_sociales.card1_desc: Building educational centers and mosques for underprivileged communities. The Al Mouslihoon Project is its cornerstone.
aides_sociales.card2_desc: Full support for orphans: Quranic and school education, food, clothing and medical follow-up.
aides_sociales.card3_desc: Regular distribution of food parcels to families in need, especially during Ramadan.
aides_sociales.card4_desc: Drilling wells in rural areas to give communities access to drinking water.
aides_sociales.card5_desc: Awarding of school scholarships to deserving students from low-income families.
aides_sociales.card6_desc: Organizing Aqiqa and ritual sacrifices for families who wish, distributing meat to the most in need.

a whole lifetime.
camp_vacances.hero_subtitle: Quran, sport and group life — caring supervision in Dakar or on the Petite Côte.
camp_vacances.programs_desc: Dakar or Petite Côte — find the program that suits your child perfectly.
camp_vacances.externat_desc: Quran classes from 9am to 5pm, lunch included. Ideal if your child sleeps at home.
camp_vacances.registration_note: One-time registration fee of 25,000 FCFA, valid for boarding or day school — payable at time of booking.
camp_vacances.included_desc: Secure accommodation, halal meals, caring supervision — everything is designed for your child's well-being.
camp_vacances.packing_desc: Here's what to bring — and what's best left at home.
camp_vacances.strict_rules: ⚠️ Strict rules. Non-compliance = sanctions or permanent exclusion.
camp_vacances.step1_desc: Cité des Magistrats, Villa Petite Côte, or day school — depending on your child's profile.
camp_vacances.step2_desc: A few minutes online to book your child's spot.
camp_vacances.step3_desc: Pay the registration fee and pack the suitcase with our checklist.
camp_vacances.faq_q1: My son is 7, can he go to the Villa de la Petite Côte?
camp_vacances.faq_a1: No. The Villa de la Petite Côte is reserved for boys aged 7 and a half and up. For younger children or girls, the Cité des Magistrats program in Dakar is open to everyone.
camp_vacances.faq_q2: Can I enroll my child for just one month?
camp_vacances.faq_a2: Yes. Rates are monthly, you choose the length of stay between July 5 and September 25, 2026.
camp_vacances.faq_q3: How can I communicate with my child during the stay?
camp_vacances.faq_a3: Personal phones are forbidden. Supervised call times are regularly organized with families via staff phones, on Sundays from 12pm to 7pm, for a maximum of 20 minutes per student.
camp_vacances.faq_q4: Does the day school include sports activities?
camp_vacances.faq_a4: No. Day students only attend Quran classes from 9am to 5pm, with lunch included. Sports activities are reserved for boarders.
camp_vacances.faq_q5: What happens in case of a rule violation?
camp_vacances.faq_a5: Any violation results in a proportionate sanction. In case of serious misconduct (forbidden item or substance), permanent expulsion from the camp is immediate.
camp_vacances.faq_q6: Can I visit the premises before enrolling my child?
camp_vacances.faq_a6: Of course. Contact us at +221 77 774 37 00 or via WhatsApp to schedule a visit.
camp_vacances.final_desc: Quran, sport, friendship and personal growth — everything a child needs to grow up confident and at peace.
camp_vacances.related1_desc: The only mixed daara in Dakar — girls AND boys accepted
camp_vacances.related3_desc: Swimming, basketball, Quran by the sea
camp_vacances.karang_desc: A humanitarian and educational project led by Al Amine Academy for the benefit of Karang's population — run independently of the vacation camp.
camp_vacances.karang_p1: The Al Mouhlisoon Project is an Al Amine Academy initiative for Senegal's most remote communities. Through collection, awareness, and direct aid activities, our students are actively involved in improving living conditions in Karang.
camp_vacances.karang_li1: Support for Quranic education in local daaras
camp_vacances.karang_li2: Distribution of school supplies and materials
camp_vacances.karang_note: The Al Mouhlisoon Karang Project is a separate charitable initiative, independent of the vacation camp. Participation is free and open to any family who wishes to contribute.
